tagMap.cmsDescription: Inspect, test, and maintain automatic sprinkler systems.
Properly install and monitor supervisory attachments on automatic sprinkler systems.
Install an approved automatic sprinkler system.
Have approved installation, maintenance and testing program for fire alarm systems.
Install a fire alarm system that can be heard throughout the facility.
Have a complete alarm system manually initiated and initiated by fire sprinkler system connection.
Have a fire alarm with audible and visual signals that transmits the alarm automatically to notify emergency forces in event of fire.
Properly provide smoke detection systems in areas open to corridors.
Properly select, install, inspect, or maintain portable fire extinguishes.
Install emergency lighting that can last at least 1 1/2 hours.
Have properly located and lighted "Exit" signs.

method.severityScale: CMS scope and severity code, A (least) to L (most); D to F is no actual harm with potential for more than minimal harm
method.repeated: the same service line was cited on more than one survey date
method.corrected: deficiency_corrected = "Deficient, Provider has date of correction"
method.ownershipChange: an ownership or partnership interest association dated on or after 2024-10-19 (24 months before retrieval), or the CMS change-of-ownership flag
method.managementChange: an organization associated with operational or managerial control on or after 2024-10-19; individual managers are excluded as routine staff turnover
method.personalData: owner names are never read into the output; only dates and roles are used
